svg.aria-label: Left: p-value paths of four A/A tests with no real difference wander below 0.05 at some point. Right: stopping at the first p below 0.05 raises the false positive rate from 5 percent with one look to about 19 percent with ten looks and about 37 percent with a hundred, while an always-valid mSPRT stays under 5 percent
